title: Untold Arctic Wars
description: The Germans begin a retreat on the eve of the polar winter; the Soviet Union begins a major offensive in the north; the Finns push the Germans towards their defensive line.

title: Air Warriors
description: The history of the B-1 Lancer reveals how the Cold War bomber evolved to become one of America's most effective military aircraft.

title: How Did They Build That?
description: Witness amazing buildings, bridges, lifts, and other structures that pushed structural concrete engineering to the edge.

title: How Did They Fix That?
description: Mike Davidson goes to the biggest automated package sorting facility in the world, UPS Worldport in Louisville, Kentucky; two million packages go through here every day.

title: World's Most Scenic River Journeys
description: The journey down the attraction-packed Niagara River is filled with adventure and beauty; navigating the fascinating history and engineering of this border river between Canada and the United States, arriving at the world-famous Niagara Falls.

title: Mysteries From Above
description: Witness animal spectacles from high above the Earth; watch a whirling herd of northern nomads; see undersea behemoths show off in the Pacific shallows; track a U.S. porcine stampede; confront top ocean predators on the Florida coast.

title: Extreme Weather Salvage
description: Crews work around the clock to build the world's largest underwater concrete bed to salvage the Costa Concordia; operating in secrecy, teams work under high security to repair one of the world's most iconic cruise liners.

title: WWII: Rise of the Tank
description: Investigating how early concepts of armoured fighting vehicles influenced the creation of the very first tank prototype; seeing how the muddy battlefields of WW I became a crucial testing ground for a machine that would soon change military history.

title: WWII: Rise of the Tank
description: Witnessing the devastating impact of the German blitzkrieg as new tank strategies take the world by storm; learning how Germany overcame the inferiority of its panzers and swept through Poland and France with innovations in logistics and strategy.

title: WWII: Rise of the Tank
description: Looking back at the wartime manufacturing boom, when countries across the world leveraged their industrial might to churn out the perfect tank; marveling at the most iconic models, including the Soviet T-34, American M4 Sherman and German Tiger I.

title: Black Panthers of WW2
description: Uncovering the inspiring stories of the U.S. Army's 761st Tank Battalion; descendants and historians discuss the honor of the first armored unit of its kind, entirely composed of African-American servicemen.

title: Americans Underground: Secret City of WWI
description: The discovery of an underground haven used by World War I soldiers.

title: 24 Hours That Changed The World
description: Part 1/2. Exploring the events that occurred twenty-four hours before the unconditional surrender of Germany and Japan, commemorating the eightieth anniversary of the end of the Second World War.

title: 24 Hours That Changed The World
description: Part 2/2. On the August 1945; after two U.S. nuclear attacks, Japan's emperor prepares the nation to surrender; the undercover miliary factions plot to fight on; how close did they get to changing history?

title: The Pacific War in Color
description: By the spring of 1945, the United States begins to take back the Philippines; on Borneo, the Australians invade Labuan; when the United States invades Okinawa, Japan makes a strong stand and launches the biggest kamikaze attacks of the war.

title: Hitler's Last Stand
description: A Japanese American regiment fights through darkened forests, heavy rains and entrenched Nazis to reach a lost U.S. battalion in the Vosges Mountains.

title: Greatest Escapes of World War II
description: Revisit Colditz Castle, a Nazi fortress where breakouts featured human catapults and clever disguises; meet the pilots who staged the famed Great Escape from a Polish stalag; see how 32 POWs pulled off the Warburg Wire Job in just one minute.

title: World War II: History On Trial
description: Go back to November 1945, when 22 Nazi leaders faced a new international tribunal in Nuremberg; see how prosecutors set a lasting precedent for global justice by proving the guilt of the accused through evidence, rather than simply seeking vengeance.

title: World War II: History On Trial
description: Explores post-war justice, tracing landmark and overlooked trials worldwide, revealing how accountability for atrocities shaped modern laws against war crimes and genocide.

title: World War II: History On Trial
description: Hermann Göring secretly schemes to sabotage the defence strategy at Nuremberg; a fractious tribunal in Tokyo convenes to prosecute 28 high-ranking Japanese war criminals.

title: World War II: History On Trial
description: Assessing the 12 post-Nuremberg trials that targeted the elite of Nazi society, from doctors to bureaucrats; Understanding how global tensions and horrifying revelations proved almost too difficult for a war-weary Germany to process and accept.
